title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Edward J. Hu, Yelong Shen, Phillip Wallis, Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Yuanzhi Li, Shean Wang, Lu Wang, and Weizhu Chen submitted 'LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models' to arXiv on June 17, 2021. The paper proposes freezing pretrained model weights while injecting trainable low-rank decomposition matrices into Transformer layers to reduce the number of trainable parameters needed for downstream adaptation.
significance: A documented parameter-efficient adaptation milestone for large pretrained language models, introducing the Low-Rank Adaptation method described in the original paper.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the title, authors, June 17 2021 initial submission date, and the core low-rank adaptation method recorded here. The authors also link the Microsoft LoRA code repository from the paper record. This candidate records only the paper-submission milestone and does not infer a software-release date, institutional geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships.
